test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers of the following set.

(12, 13, 76)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**The second number × 6 - (second number - first number) × 2 = third number**

For (12, 13, 76)

13 × 6 - (13 - 12) × 2

= 78 - 1 × 2

= 78 - 2 = 76 (third number)

Option 1: (21, 25, 125)

= 25 × 6 - (25 - 21) × 2 

= 150 - 4 × 2

= 150 - 8 = 142 ≠ 125

Option 2: (9, 10, 45)

= 10 × 6 - (10 - 9) × 2

= 60 - 1 × 2 

= 60 - 2 = 58 ≠ 45

**Option 3: (15, 17, 98)**

**= 17 × 6 - (17 - 15) × 2**

**= 102 - 2 × 2**

**= 102 - 4 = 98 (third number)**

Option 4: (11, 13, 62)

= 13 × 6 - (13 - 11) × 2

= 78 - 2 × 2 

= 78 - 4 = 74 ≠ 62

Hence, the correct answer is** "(15, 17, 98)".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**The pattern followed here is:

2nd number × 5 + 1st number - (2nd number - 1st number) = 3rd number.

For (12, 13, 76)

= 13 × 5 + 12 - (13 - 12)

= 65 + 12 - 1

= 77 - 1 = 76 (third number)

Similarly, 

**Option 3: (15, 17, 98)**

**= 17 × 5 + 15 - (17 - 15)**

**= 85 + 15 - 2**

**= 100 - 2 = 98 (third number)**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
